## Relationships

### [Averil](../character/averil.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/averil--perceval.md)

Perceval is a fictional character in a story who is romantically involved with [Averil](../character/averil.md). Their bond is defined by dramatic romantic gestures, such as when he clasps her in his arms and calls her his sweetheart.

- Romantically involved with — fictional romance character who clasps her in his arms and calls her sweetheart  <sub>[v3 ch.Down P22](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0022)</sub>

### [Maurice Lennox](../character/maurice-lennox.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maurice-lennox--perceval.md)

Perceval and [Maurice Lennox](../character/maurice-lennox.md) are adversaries within the narrative crafted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Maurice acts as Perceval's enemy by persecuting him, while simultaneously serving as his rival as they both compete for Averil's affections.

- Enemy of — persecuted by him in Anne's story  <sub>[v3 ch.Atonement” P32](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0032)</sub>
- Rival of — competing for Averil's affections in Anne's story  <sub>[v3 ch.Atonement” P47](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0047)</sub>
